# Get rFishBase data and filter for functional group

```{r}
# Dummy length–weight (TL in cm → mass in g)
a_dummy <- 0.010
b_dummy <- 3.00

# Helper: make order-of-magnitude mass bins (10^k ... 10^(k+1) g)
make_mass_bins <- function(mass_g, k_min = NULL, k_max = NULL) {
  lg <- log10(mass_g)
  k_min <- if (is.null(k_min)) floor(min(lg, na.rm = TRUE)) else k_min
  k_max <- if (is.null(k_max)) ceiling(max(lg, na.rm = TRUE)) else k_max
  # bin edges: 10^k_min, 10^(k_min+1), ..., 10^k_max
  edges <- 10^(seq(k_min, k_max, by = 1))
  labs  <- paste0("10^", seq(k_min, k_max-1), "–10^", seq(k_min+1, k_max), " g")
  list(edges = edges, labels = labs)
}
```

```{r}
species_tbl <- fb_tbl("species") %>% 
  mutate(sci_name = paste(Genus, Species)) %>%
  filter(Saltwater == 1) %>%
  select(sci_name, Genus, Species, Length, DemersPelag) %>%
  # dummy mass from Length (assumes TL in cm in FishBase "Length")
  mutate(mass_g = a_dummy * Length ^ b_dummy)

# Check which functional groups are available
unique(species_tbl$DemersPelag)

# Filter functional group (pelagics, as in your example)
pelagic_labels <- c("demersal") #c("pelagic-neritic", "pelagic-oceanic", "pelagic")
fishes_of_interest <- species_tbl %>%
  filter(DemersPelag %in% pelagic_labels, is.finite(mass_g))

# Build order-of-magnitude bin edges/labels from the pelagic set
bins <- make_mass_bins(fishes_of_interest$mass_g)
# Assign a mass_bin factor to each species
fishes_of_interest <- fishes_of_interest %>%
  mutate(
    mass_bin = cut(mass_g, breaks = bins$edges, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE,
                   labels = bins$labels)
  )

#fishes_of_interest <- fishes_of_interest[0:9,] # testing example; comment out if script is ready

# Keep a compact lookup for the OBIS join
sp_lookup <- fishes_of_interest %>%
  select(sci_name, mass_g, mass_bin)
species_names <- fishes_of_interest$sci_name
```


## Get rOBIS data for functional group and record missing species

```{r}
# Set up parallel processing
plan(multisession, workers = 32)  # Use available cores

# Function to fetch OBIS data safely
get_obis_data <- function(species) {
  message("Fetching OBIS data for: ", species)
  tryCatch({
    data <- occurrence(species)
    if (!is.null(data) && nrow(data) > 0) {
      data <- data %>% mutate(species = species)  # Keep track of species name
      return(data)
    } else {
      return(NULL)  # No data found
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("No data found for: ", species)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Fetch OBIS data in parallel
obis_list <- future_lapply(species_names, get_obis_data)

# Combine valid data & record missing species
obis_data <- bind_rows(obis_list)
missing_species <- species_names[which(sapply(obis_list, is.null))]

# Save missing species to a file
writeLines(missing_species, here("data/missing_species.txt"))
```


```{r}
# Initialize list to store OBIS data and missing species
obis_list <- list()
missing_species <- c()

for (species in species_names) {
  message("Fetching OBIS data for: ", species)
  temp_data <- tryCatch(
    occurrence(species),
    error = function(e) {
      message("No data found for: ", species)
      missing_species <<- c(missing_species, species)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )
  
  if (!is.null(temp_data) && nrow(temp_data) > 0) {
    temp_data <- temp_data %>%
      mutate(species = species) # Keep track of the species name
    obis_list[[species]] <- temp_data
  }
}

# Combine all valid OBIS data
obis_data <- bind_rows(obis_list)

# Attach mass info/bins to each OBIS record
obis_data <- obis_data %>%
  mutate(species = ifelse(is.na(species), scientificName, species)) %>%  # safety
  rename(LATITUDE = decimalLatitude, LONGITUDE = decimalLongitude) %>%
  left_join(sp_lookup, by = c("species" = "sci_name")) #%>%
  #filter(!is.na(mass_bin))  # drop species with no mass estimate

# Save missing species to a file
#writeLines(missing_species, here("data/missing_species.txt"))
```


# Snap OBIS to WOA grid & merge environment

```{r}
# Reshape WOA (as you had it)
woa_temp_long <- woa_temp %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("X"), names_to = "depth_m", values_to = "temperature") %>%
  mutate(depth_m = as.numeric(sub("^X","",depth_m)))

woa_oxy_long <- woa_oxy %>% 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("X"), names_to = "depth_m", values_to = "oxygen") %>%
  mutate(depth_m = as.numeric(sub("^X","",depth_m)))

woa_data <- full_join(woa_temp_long, woa_oxy_long, by = c("LATITUDE","LONGITUDE","depth_m"))

# Central depth and grid snapping
obis_binned <- obis_data %>%
  mutate(
    min_depth = ifelse(is.na(minimumDepthInMeters), NA, minimumDepthInMeters),
    max_depth = ifelse(is.na(maximumDepthInMeters), NA, maximumDepthInMeters),
    central_depth = case_when(
      !is.na(min_depth) & !is.na(max_depth) ~ (min_depth + max_depth)/2,
      !is.na(min_depth) ~ min_depth,
      !is.na(max_depth) ~ max_depth,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na(central_depth) %>%
  mutate(
    LATITUDE  = round(LATITUDE  / 1) * 1 + 0.5,
    LONGITUDE = round(LONGITUDE / 1) * 1 + 0.5
  )

# Depth matching
woa_depths <- unique(woa_data$depth_m)
obis_binned <- obis_binned %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(nearest_woa_depth = woa_depths[which.min(abs(woa_depths - central_depth))]) %>%
  ungroup()

# Join environment (keep mass_bin)
combined_data <- obis_binned %>%
  left_join(woa_data, by = c("LATITUDE","LONGITUDE","nearest_woa_depth" = "depth_m")) %>%
  group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) %>%
  mutate(
    temperature = ifelse(is.na(temperature), min(temperature, na.rm = TRUE), temperature),
    oxygen      = ifelse(is.na(oxygen),      min(oxygen,      na.rm = TRUE), oxygen)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(is.finite(oxygen), is.finite(temperature)) %>%
  mutate(
    temperature = pmax(pmin(temperature, 30), 0),
    oxygen      = pmax(pmin(oxygen,      30), 0)
  )
```


# Plotting

```{r}
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = temperature, y = oxygen)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 50) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,30), ylim = c(0,30)) +
  ggtitle("Demersal occurrences (all masses)") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", na.value = "white", trans = "log10") +
  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "pO2 (kPa)", fill = "Occurrences") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = temperature, y = oxygen)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 50) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0,30), ylim = c(0,30)) +
  facet_wrap(~ mass_bin, ncol = 3) +
  ggtitle("Demersal occurrences by mass bin (order-of-magnitude)") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", na.value = "white", trans = "log10") +
  labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "pO2 (kPa)", fill = "Occurrences") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
